description: A My device invitation issued by another person (Rosa) is accepted on Daniel's computer's Link page with no confirmation; the computer silently adopts Rosa's identity and opens her project as "You: Rosa Alvarez". Nothing shows whose identity the invitation carries before linking, and the Git-prefilled 'Daniel Kim' is discarded.
expected: Before linking, show 'This invitation links this computer as Rosa Alvarez (rosa@q4labs.io). Continue only if you are Rosa.', or warn when the sponsor identity differs from the local Git/prefilled identity.
actual: Linked immediately; board header shows You: Rosa Alvarez.
suggested_fix: Decode and display the sponsor name/email from the invitation (or a server preflight) and require explicit confirmation; flag a mismatch with the suggested identity.

description: After the Human invitation is refused on the Link page, the person must go Back (which discards the pasted text), confirm identity, open Join a project and paste again. The app already knows it is a valid Human invitation.
expected: An action such as 'Confirm identity and join with this invitation' that carries the pasted invitation into the Join flow.
actual: Back clears the textarea; the invitation has to be pasted a second time.
suggested_fix: Keep the pasted text in state across Back and prefill the Join form after identity confirmation, or add a one-click path from the refusal.

description: Every person's setup agent is named "Setup agent" with initials SA, so a project with two people shows two identical SA avatars in the header (and two 'Setup agent · agent' entries in Assigned to).
expected: Agents are distinguishable at a glance, e.g. 'Daniel's agent' / 'Rosa's agent' or the harness name.
actual: Two identical SA avatars side by side.
suggested_fix: Default the agent display name to '<Owner first name>'s agent' and include the owner in the avatar label.

description: A truncated or doubled Human invitation is reported as "Paste one complete My device invitation.", steering a person who has the wrong kind of invitation towards a kind they don't have.
expected: "This doesn't look like one complete invitation. Copy it again from the sender."
suggested_fix: Use a purpose-neutral message for malformed input.

description: Each refusal shows a headline and then a hint restating the same rule ("Confirm your identity first…" / "…work after you confirm your identity.").
actual: Two sentences saying the same thing in one error box.
suggested_fix: Drop the DEVICE_INVITATION_REQUIRED hint when the headline already gives the purpose-specific instruction.
